unit_test_note: tests/test_style_signal.cpp first asserted that a uniform wash on fibred paper stays uniform. It failed: deposition rises with the crossing density, so suspended pigment becomes uneven and moves. The assertion was wrong, not the reference; the test now uses paper with no fibres, as the web bounds' uniform_wash_no_fibres test does.
